title: Bound duplicate Fourfold cross-plane label admission before production change

research_question.observation: Cross-plane Fourfold bindings are already revision-checked and endpoint-membership-checked by FourfoldSnapshot, but boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold converts their verified labels to coordinates and TypedRelationBlock.from_coordinates performs label admission and label-position lookup again before delegating to the existing indexed block owner.
research_question.candidate: For the complete cross-plane valid path only, map already-verified binding endpoints to local axis indices and delegate directly to the existing TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed owner, retaining the exact Forest/Fourfold subject checks, complete-plane requirement, Boolean semantics, and final canonical TypedRelationBlock validation.

bounded_probe.runtime: CPython 3.12.14 on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 / Linux Azure
bounded_probe.measurement: 11 paired same-process AB/BA observations after 3 warmups for each of six deterministic valid complete cross-plane fixtures
bounded_probe.semantic_check: Before timing, candidate == baseline, canonical digest equality, and canonical JSON equality were required; every timed candidate result was also required to retain the baseline digest.
bounded_probe.interpretation: All six bounded valid fixture shapes retained byte/canonical identity and had a lower candidate median in this one hosted process. This is decision evidence for the local cross-plane projection path only, not a production or repository-wide speedup claim; error-path equivalence outside the retained top-level checks was not established by this probe.

hosted_evidence.checkout_semantics: GitHub pull-request merge preview; not a raw-head checkout claim

decision: The bounded valid-path evidence is strong enough to license one later minimal in-place production experiment in relation_projection.py that removes only duplicate cross-plane label admission by reusing the existing indexed block owner. Any such packet must preserve exact Forest/Fourfold binding checks, complete endpoint semantics, canonical block identity, failure behavior for invalid top-level subjects, and must not expose a trusted constructor or second validation authority.
next_bounded_packet: Implement only the licensed cross-plane indexed projection in place, add focused regression coverage for canonical equality and retained refusals, and reject the change if exact-head integration or bounded before/after evidence does not support it. Do not alter same-plane Forest relation projection in the same packet.
